name: resume-screening-chat
description: Screen pasted or uploaded CVs against a job description or screening matrix. Emits resume-screening-report. Assistive only; not a hire decision.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include JD, screening matrix, resume paste, or attachments.

inputs.name: screening-matrix
inputs.description: Pasted screening matrix from job-post-quality-chat or internal rubric.

inputs.name: resume-text
inputs.description: One candidate resume paste (repeat per candidate in chat).

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from a prior clarification loop.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: resume-screening-report
outputs.description: Structured screening notes; empty when criteria or CV are missing.
